author: Tempus
body:
As a player with.. decent amount of time online, I would like to put an idea forward - 1v1v1v1 walls.

We could have up to 8 people (the size of a regular game), but with smaller maps. 1 person on each team, no teaming, and essentially a hunger games with pre assigned areas.

So, whaddaya think?

replies.body: -1 waste of server space. Funky/Ivy has to pay a lot for the 60-80 servers we have right now just to keep it up. Also it would bring lots of stress to the devs needing to set up the whole plugin and maps for the 1v1.

replies.author: Murphh
replies.body: I like this idea.  Maybe more of a mini-walls with 3-5 minutes prep.  Maps could come from the community.  I don't know if it would need a separate plugin.  Wouldn't the YML take care of the # of players, spawn points, length of game, map size, etc...?
